transcribe.description: Writes down the sentences said in a video or a sound, with the time each starts and ends. The core may run it a window of the media at a time and join the result: the sentences are joined, text is put together from them and durationMs is the whole media's; language and model are the first window's.

media.description: The video or sound: an object with an absolute file path (a stored file, or a video as media.open gives it) or a path in text.

model.description: The speech model: tiny, base, small, medium or large-v3, with .en for English only (default tiny). Downloaded once, on first use.

language.description: The language as a code such as en or pt (default: found out from the first seconds).

skipSilence.description: Skip the stretches with no speech. It stops the model from inventing words in silence, but it can drop speech that sits over loud music (default false).

beamSize.description: How many alternatives are weighed: more is slower and a little better (default 5).

failures.description: A param is wrong or media is missing.
No speech could be read from the file (it is damaged or has no audio).
The model could not be loaded: usually no network the first time, or a name that is not a model.
